title: Rocher - Location & Weakness (Stone Wave Cliffs)
description: The Rocher optional boss in Expedition 33's Stone Wave Cliffs: where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistance.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Rocher is an optional boss found in the Stone Wave Cliffs. It is a rock-type encounter, and its elemental profile is the main thing to prepare for.

sections.title: Where to Find the Rocher
sections.content:
Location: Stone Wave Cliffs.

It is encountered while exploring the cliffs during Act 1, rather than hidden away in an optional side area.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce
ResistsFire

A clean opposite pairing: bring Ice, avoid Fire. Fire damage is actively wasted here.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
Rocher's specific drop list is not documented in the sources we could verify, so we are leaving it out rather than guessing.

As a Stone Wave Cliffs encounter during Act 1, it sits in the same reward tier as other early optional bosses - standard Chroma Catalysts and upgrade materials rather than a unique weapon.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.content:
Because Rocher resists Fire and is weak to Ice, check your equipped weapons' damage types before the fight - a Fire-scaling weapon will make this take far longer than it should.

The GSC query pattern around this boss is people looking for the rock boss location, which suggests it is easy to pass by. It is in the Stone Wave Cliffs proper, not an optional side cavern.
